newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sembawang, FedEx in HK venture.
newsitem.headline: Sembawang, FedEx in HK venture.

text.p: Sembawang Express Pte Ltd, a unit of Sembawang Corp's transportation and logistics group, said on Wednesday it had set up an Express Distribution Centre (EDC) in Hong Kong with Federal Express.

The company said in a statement the facility, to be managed by its subsidiary Sembawang Express (HK) Pte Ltd, would offer services including inventory management, distribution and freight forwarding in Hong Kong and North Asia.
The statement said the move would enable Sembawang Express HK to access the huge Chinese market.
It said the company had already secured contracts to service major clients from the electronics and computer industries such as U.S. National Semiconductor Corp and C-Cube.
Billy Lee, chairman of Sembawang Express HK said the company had plans to expand into China and was likely to set up a Beijing facility in the first quarter of 1997.
Lee added Asia's integrated logistics market was expected to grow at an annual rate of at least 25 percent over the next decade.
